title: Isolation and Semi Quantitative PCR of Na+/H+ Antiporter Genes under Salinity Stress in Kochia scoparia
author: Fahmideh, Fooladvand

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from K. scoparia samples using the Total RNA isolation kit (DENA Zist Asia) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe the isolated RNA with HyperScript reverse transcriptase (Gene All) using oligod(T) 18mer and the gene‑specific reverse primers P.SOS.S-REV1, P.SOS.S-REV2, P.SOS.S-REV3, P.SOS.S-REV4, P.NHX.S.REV1, P.NHX.S.REV2 and P.NHX.S.REV3 (Table 1).

substeps.instruction: Prepare reverse‑transcription mix with HyperScript reverse transcriptase, oligod(T) 18mer, and the listed primers.
Incubate under the conditions recommended by the enzyme supplier.

steps.title: Amplify cDNA by PCR
steps.instruction: Set up PCR reactions with the cDNA template, the appropriate primer combinations (Table 2), and TaqDNA polymerase (AMPLIQON); run 30 cycles with the defined annealing temperature for each primer pair, then perform a final extension for 5–15 min at 720 °C.

substeps.instruction: Combine cDNA, primer pair, AMPLIQON TaqDNA polymerase, dNTPs, buffer, and water to the required volume.
Program the thermocycler: initial denaturation, 30 cycles of denaturation, annealing (temperature specific to each primer pair), extension, and a final extension step of 5–15 min at 720 °C.

steps.title: Run ethidium bromide gel
steps.instruction: Separate the PCR products on an agarose gel stained with ethidium bromide.

substeps.instruction: Prepare agarose gel of appropriate concentration and add ethidium bromide.
Load PCR products and a DNA ladder into the wells.
Run electrophoresis at the voltage suitable for the gel size.

steps.title: Capture gel image
steps.instruction: Image the ethidium bromide‑stained gel using the Vilber documentation system (E‑BOX CX5).

steps.title: Quantify band intensity and normalize
steps.instruction: Measure band intensity as relative absorbance units, calculate the ratio of each sample’s total RNA to 18S rRNA, normalize the data to 18S rRNA, and compute mean and standard deviation for all experiments.

substeps.instruction: Use image analysis software to obtain relative absorbance units for each band.
Determine the total RNA/18S rRNA ratio for each sample.
Calculate the mean and standard deviation across replicates.
